laws.rule: Alhambra tickets are in the visitor's name and can't be transferred; bring the original passport or ID named on the ticket, as staff may check it at the entrances.
laws.heading: Patronato de la Alhambra y Generalife (Junta de Andalucía)

laws.rule: In Sierra Nevada National and Natural Park, swimming in the high mountain lakes (lagunas), camping on the borreguiles (wet alpine meadows), washing items in lakes and streams, and leaving the paths are not allowed, and rubbish must be carried out. Free camping is not allowed under Decree 164/2003. Bivouac and night camping need written notification (see zone requirements).
laws.heading: Información al visitante, Parque Nacional y Natural de Sierra Nevada (Junta de Andalucía)

laws.rule: In Andalusia it is banned to light a fire in forest land and in the forest influence zone around it, except where the fire law expressly allows or authorises it, and to throw or leave burning objects or anything that could start a fire (article 28(1) of Ley 5/1999). Walking on public forest land can be limited or banned in the danger zones in the highest-risk seasons (article 28(2)). Some activities need prior authorisation (article 29). The fine scale and the season dates were not read.
laws.heading: Ley 5/1999, de 29 de junio, de Prevención y Lucha Contra los Incendios Forestales (Andalucía), arts 28 and 29 (BOE consolidated)

laws.rule: Andalusia's Ley 7/2006 bans remaining in a group in open public spaces (streets, squares and other outdoor public land) to drink or do other things that endanger peaceful coexistence, except in zones the council has designated as permitted (article 3(a)). Licensed restaurant and bar terraces during their legal hours, and official local fiestas, fairs and authorised gatherings, are outside the law's scope (article 2). Selling or handing out alcoholic drinks from hospitality venues for consumption off the premises (other than authorised adjoining areas) is banned (article 3(d)), as is anyone under 18 drinking alcohol in those open public spaces (article 3(h)). A light offence (drinking outside a permitted zone, or under-18 drinking there) can be a warning or a fine of up to EUR 300 (about A$477, RBA rate of 30 October 2026); serious offences start at EUR 301 and very serious offences at EUR 24,001 (article 9).

layers.authority: Caminito del Rey (UTE Caminito del Rey, official ticket site)
layers.process: The Caminito del Rey walkway (Málaga) is entered by ticket bought on the official site or at the north-access ticket office. General entry is EUR 10 (limit of 10 tickets per purchase), an official guided visit EUR 18, shuttle bus EUR 2.50 and parking EUR 2 (about A$15.89 and A$28.60 for entry and guided visit at the RBA rate of 30 October 2026, A$1 = EUR 0.6293). Children under 8 cannot enter; visitors over 8 must bring original ID or the Family Book to prove age. The page states no daily cap or release window.

layers.authority: Parque Nacional y Natural de Sierra Nevada (Junta de Andalucía)
layers.process: In Sierra Nevada, free camping is not allowed. Bivouac (sleeping in the open) and night camping (a light tent between one hour before sunset and one hour after sunrise) are allowed only after a written notification to the park director: name of the person in charge, ID number, address, phone, number of people (max 15), number of tents (max 3) and place; carry a copy. Not allowed in reserve zones (borreguiles, lake edges), within 50 m of high mountain lakes and streams, within 500 m of staffed mountain refuges and open roads or forest tracks, more than one night in the same place, or in wooded forest zones from 1 June to 15 October. The leaflet is undated; confirm with the park office.
